lines.text: Joab refuses to let Ahimaaz carry the news, sends a Cushite, then lets Ahimaaz run and he outruns the Cushite.
David sits between the two gates while a watchman on the roof sees two men running alone, and the king says each brings good news.
Ahimaaz tells David all is well and that he saw a great tumult, and the Cushite then tells David Absalom is dead.

wrong_details.wrong: Ahimaaz tells David all is well and that he saw a great tumult, and the Cushite then tells David Absalom is dead.
wrong_details.true: Ahimaaz said he saw a great tumult but did not know what it was; the Cushite answered with the wish that the king's enemies be like the young man.

lines.text: David goes up to the chamber over the gate and weeps, wishing he had died instead of Absalom, and the people return to the city quietly.
Joab tells David to go out and comfort his servants or half his men will leave him, so David sits in the forest of Ephraim.

wrong_details.wrong: half his men will leave him
wrong_details.true: not a man will remain with him tonight

wrong_details.wrong: David sits in the forest of Ephraim
wrong_details.true: the king got up and sat in the gate
